e4729942-438b-491c-bc36-b6a831fcbcf2.plantuml_code:
@startuml
actor Member
actor Librarian
actor Administrator
actor Guest
participant HomePage
participant LoginPage
participant LoginController
participant UserDetailsPage
participant BookCatalog
participant BookDetailsPage
participant ReservationController
participant IssueController
participant ReturnController
participant BookManager
participant MemberManager
== Member Login and View Details ==
Member -> HomePage: clickLoginButton()
activate HomePage
HomePage -> LoginPage: displayLoginPage()
deactivate HomePage
activate LoginPage
Member -> LoginPage: enterCredentials(loginId, password)
LoginPage -> LoginController: submitCredentials(loginId, password)
activate LoginController
LoginController -> LoginController: validateRequiredInfo()
alt invalid info
LoginController -> LoginPage: promptReenterDetails()
deactivate LoginController
LoginPage -> Member: displayError("Re-enter details")
deactivate LoginPage
else valid info
LoginController -> LoginController: validateCredentials()
alt credentials valid
LoginController -> LoginPage: loginSuccess()
deactivate LoginController
LoginPage -> Member: displayLoggedIn()
deactivate LoginPage
Member -> UserDetailsPage: clickViewUserDetails()
activate UserDetailsPage
UserDetailsPage -> MemberManager: getMemberDetails()
activate MemberManager
MemberManager -> UserDetailsPage: returnMemberDetails()
deactivate MemberManager
UserDetailsPage -> Member: displayMemberDetails()
deactivate UserDetailsPage
else credentials invalid
LoginController -> LoginPage: promptReenterDetails()
deactivate LoginController
LoginPage -> Member: displayError("Invalid credentials")
deactivate LoginPage
end
end
== Book Search and View ==
Member -> BookCatalog: viewCategories()
activate BookCatalog
BookCatalog -> Member: displayCategories()
deactivate BookCatalog
Member -> BookCatalog: selectCategory(category)
activate BookCatalog
BookCatalog -> BookManager: getBooksByCategory(category)
activate BookManager
BookManager -> BookCatalog: returnBooksList()
deactivate BookManager
BookCatalog -> Member: displayBooksList()
deactivate BookCatalog
Member -> BookDetailsPage: selectBook(bookId)
activate BookDetailsPage
BookDetailsPage -> BookManager: getBookDetails(bookId)
activate BookManager
BookManager -> BookDetailsPage: returnBookDetails()
deactivate BookManager
BookDetailsPage -> Member: displayBookDetails()
deactivate BookDetailsPage
== Book Reservation by Librarian ==
Librarian -> ReservationController: reserveBookForMember(memberId, bookId)
activate ReservationController
ReservationController -> BookManager: checkBookAvailability(bookId)
activate BookManager
BookManager -> ReservationController: returnAvailability()
deactivate BookManager
alt book available
ReservationController -> ReservationController: reserveBook(memberId, bookId)
ReservationController -> Librarian: confirmReservation()
else book not available
ReservationController -> Librarian: promptSelectAnotherBook()
end
deactivate ReservationController
== Book Issue by Librarian ==
Librarian -> IssueController: issueBookToMember(memberId, bookId)
activate IssueController
IssueController -> BookManager: validateBookAvailability(bookId)
activate BookManager
BookManager -> IssueController: returnAvailability()
deactivate BookManager
IssueController -> MemberManager: checkIssuedBooksCount(memberId)
activate MemberManager
MemberManager -> IssueController: returnIssuedCount()
deactivate MemberManager
alt can issue
IssueController -> IssueController: issueBook(memberId, bookId)
IssueController -> Librarian: confirmIssue()
else cannot issue
IssueController -> Librarian: displayError("Max books issued")
end
deactivate IssueController
== Book Return by Member ==
Member -> ReturnController: returnBook(bookId, memberId)
activate ReturnController
ReturnController -> BookManager: validateBookId(bookId)
activate BookManager
BookManager -> ReturnController: returnValidation()
deactivate BookManager
alt valid book id
ReturnController -> ReturnController: processReturn(bookId, memberId)
ReturnController -> Member: displayMessage("Book returned successfully")
else invalid book id
ReturnController -> Member: promptReenterBookId()
end
deactivate ReturnController
== Add/Remove Book by Librarian ==
Librarian -> BookManager: addBook(bookDetails)
activate BookManager
BookManager -> Librarian: confirmBookAdded()
deactivate BookManager
Librarian -> BookManager: removeBook(bookId)
activate BookManager
BookManager -> Librarian: confirmBookRemoved()
deactivate BookManager
== Add/Remove Member by Administrator ==
Administrator -> MemberManager: addMember(memberDetails)
activate MemberManager
MemberManager -> Administrator: confirmMemberAdded()
deactivate MemberManager
Administrator -> MemberManager: removeMember(memberId, reason)
activate MemberManager
MemberManager -> Administrator: confirmMemberRemoved()
deactivate MemberManager
@enduml
